unsupported: After two decades in the furniture industry, the Robbins family set out to create their own line of stylish, value-priced stationery upholstery, building on the region’s generations-long tradition of furniture making.
The brand targets residential customers seeking mid-range upholstered furniture, and its wholesale model serves furniture retailers looking for reliable, domestically produced inventory.

The Robbins family emphasizes a “fusion of style, value, and service,” citing above-average customer support and a commitment to community initiatives—including partnerships with the American Cancer Society, I AM ALS, CASA, and the Salvation Army—as core to the company’s identity.

Known for: American-made furniture manufactured in Mississippi; Over 450,000 sq ft of manufacturing space with 500+ employees; Family-owned and operated since founding in 2009; Distributed through independent retailers across the US, Canada, and Mexico; Commitment to style, value, and service with community partnerships
